Who it is for

Aspirants building a GK base from zero, and anyone revising facts the week before a paper.

Buy it if

You want one affordable book that covers the static half of the GK syllabus end to end.

Avoid it if

You already maintain your own static GK notes - this adds nothing new.

How to use it

Read the sections that map to your syllabus once for coverage, then only the highlighted facts on later passes.

Pros and cons

Pros

  • The whole static GK syllabus in one slim volume
  • Point-form pages that are quick to revise the week before a paper
  • Cheap enough to buy beside a subject book

Cons

  • Explanations are brief - it summarises rather than teaches
  • Punjab-specific coverage is thin next to a state GK book

Topics covered

  • Indian history
  • Indian polity
  • Geography
  • Economy
  • General science
